restInst.description:
An instance of the REST type created in the `baseCodeAnalyzer` package to add additional source control APIs
on top of what's provided in {@link platformRestInst}.

platformRestInst.description:
An instance of the C3 AI Platform REST type used to interact with the source control host.
Example: {@link GitHub}.

spec.description: The spec from which this source control gadget was created.

title: Base type for {@link BaseCodeAnalyzer} to interact with a source control system repository through REST.
name: BaseCodeAnalyzer.SourceControlGadget
